newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-SECOND DIVISION HERACLES SINK AJAX.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SECOND DIVISION HERACLES SINK AJAX.

text.p: Second division side Heracles Almelo put Ajax Amsterdam deeper into misery when they beat the reigning champions 1-0 in the second round of the Dutch Cup on Wednesday.
Heracles striker Jorg Smeets hammered home a left foot shot in the 53rd minute to settle the match and compound the Ajax woe.
A year ago Ajax were on a high having just won the world club cup in Tokyo, but Wednesday's defeat was the third in recent weeks although on Sunday they battled out a 1-1 draw at Feyenoord Rotterdam.
They are a modest fifth in the Dutch league and could well miss out qualifying for the European Cup quarter-finals.
In other domestic cup action, league leaders PSV Eindhoven beat second division VVV Venlo 2-1, while second-placed Feyenoord won 2-0 against the amateurs of Baronie Breda.
